opening.argument: The presentation pairs a promise of extraordinary returns with a minimal entry cost: participants are told they can make millions with “.0044 BNB equivalent to 2.5 dollar entry cost,” while the platform is described as “totally risk-free liability free and no loss.” That promise is tied to a structured recruitment system, not passive participation. The minimum requirement is to introduce two people for BNB earnings, and a further upgrade fee is directed to a second-level upline. A displayed level-income table organizes ranks, participant counts, upgrades, and BNB rewards, while the dashboard displays referral and level income alongside a large community size. These materials consistently present a recruitment-based, tiered BNB opportunity, although the figures, payouts, account ownership, and external destination remain unverified.
